# Samaksh Travels

> Samaksh Travels is a travel agency in Udhampur, Jammu and Kashmir, India. It books flights, trains, buses, cabs and tempo travellers, hotels and houseboats, Vaishno Devi yatras, Kashmir tours, and group, wedding and corporate travel, for travellers anywhere in India and abroad. Bookings are handled by phone and WhatsApp by a local team.

- Address: Opp. 35 BRTF GREF Gate, Dhar Road, Udhampur 182101, Jammu and Kashmir, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 94199 61983, +91 94191 61983
- Email: inquiry@samakshtravels.com
- Languages: English, Hindi
- Areas served: Udhampur, Jammu, Katra, Srinagar, Patnitop, all of Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal, rest of India and international trips
- Prices: given as a written quote per enquiry, listing inclusions and exclusions; no prices are published on the website
- Reply time: target first reply within 4 hours

## Pages

- [Home](https://samakshtravels.com/): all services, destinations, how booking works, FAQ and enquiry form
- [Vaishno Devi yatra](https://samakshtravels.com/vaishno-devi-yatra/): cab or tempo traveller to Katra, Katra hotels, train and flight tickets, helicopter booking help
- [Kashmir tour packages](https://samakshtravels.com/kashmir-tour-packages/): Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam and Sonamarg trips with cab, hotel and houseboat stays
- [Udhampur to Jammu cab](https://samakshtravels.com/udhampur-to-jammu-cab/): airport and railway station transfers, one-way or round trip
- [Udhampur to Srinagar cab](https://samakshtravels.com/udhampur-to-srinagar-cab/): cab and tempo traveller to Srinagar and the Kashmir valley

## How to book

Send the enquiry form on the home page, message on WhatsApp, or call. The team replies with a clear quote; after the customer confirms and pays, every ticket, hotel and driver is confirmed and the itinerary is sent.
